files.reference: regression values, checked against example_2004.dwg (AutoCAD DXF reference): same entity counts, types, extents, geometry, colours, lineweights and texts. R14 differences: no $INSUNITS, upper-case layer and linetype names, renumbered handles (ARC 449), and POLYLINE 41A lacks its last vertex (LibreDWG R14 limitation; the import report shows the reader warning with the DXF/PDF guidance)
